## Summary

Dovecote Learning Ltd (policy CC-1629): theft from a locked office overnight of a soldering station and an oscilloscope at a rented studio on Pike Street. Covered under clause 4.2; reserve 5,876 dollars.

## Facts

Dovecote Learning Ltd reported the loss on 16 April 2026 under policy CC-1629 [notice of loss]. The loss was theft from a locked office overnight at a rented studio on Pike Street [notice of loss], [police report]. The items are a soldering station and an oscilloscope [notice of loss], [police report]. The theft was reported to the police under reference CR/2026/4221, in a report dated 18 April 2026 [police report]. The items were in a locked container at the time [police report]. The soldering station was invoiced at 4,829 dollars by Beacon Office Supply [invoice 1]. The oscilloscope was invoiced at 1,047 dollars by Crane & Sons Electronics [invoice 2]. The file does not state the date of the theft, and it does not include the policy schedule.

## Coverage analysis

The loss falls under clause 4.2, which covers loss of or damage to business contents at the named premises, and at any other premises while in the insured's custody, caused by theft [policy]. The loss is theft of business equipment from a rented studio [notice of loss], [police report]. The schedule is not in the file, so the named premises cannot be checked against it. The claim therefore rests on the "other premises while in the insured's custody" limb of clause 4.2 [policy].

The other clauses in the extract do not apply to a theft loss: transit (4.5), escape of water (4.7) and electrical surge (4.9) [policy], [notice of loss].

- **Exclusion 7.1 (unattended property)** does not apply. It removes cover for theft of portable equipment left unattended in a shared or public space unless the equipment was in a locked container or locked room. The theft was from a locked office, and the items were in a locked container [police report], [policy].
- **Exclusion 7.3 (wear and tear)** does not apply. The loss is a theft, not gradual deterioration [notice of loss], [policy].
- **Exclusion 7.5 (unproven loss)** does not apply on the file as it stands. The police report is dated 18 April 2026, two days after the notice of loss of 16 April 2026 [police report], [notice of loss], [policy]. The theft occurred overnight before the notice was given [notice of loss]. The exact date of the theft is not in the file and should be confirmed to complete the seven-day check.

## Decision

Covered under clause 4.2. The claim is accepted, subject to confirming the date of the theft and the schedule's premises and excess.

## Reserve

The reserve is 5,876 dollars, the sum of the two invoices (4,829 dollars and 1,047 dollars) [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. Clause 9.1 deducts the 250-dollar excess only where the schedule applies one, and none applies where the schedule shows none [policy]. The schedule is not in the file and no excess is shown, so none is deducted. If the schedule shows the 250-dollar excess, the reserve becomes 5,626 dollars.
